2) Week 1: Procurement signs order form (pilot SKU + payment terms).
3) Week 1–2: Technical onboarding: containment environment, key exchange, prefix caching enabled.
4) Day 15: Start pilot; evaluation checkpoints at Day 7 and Day 30.

- DPA must be agreed before production keys are issued; we can provide test keys for earlier validation.
- If MedAlign needs data residency assurances, that may add 3–5 business days for Private deployment approvals.
- If legal requests additional logging artifacts, we can surface token-level traces but will need a SOC/controls sign-off.

I included Monica to help manage the procurement sequencing. From our side, target signature window is Aug 31–Sep 3 so the pilot can kick on Sep 6. If MedAlign can accept test keys for the first week, we can front-load onboarding work while legal finishes the DPA.
